about: Vantage is a fictional carrier. These are real plan SHAPES with our own names and illustrative prices, modelled on how US carriers sell online as seen on 2026-09-30 (two plan families side by side; per-line prices that fall with lines on AutoPay; perks at $10-15 a line; a mobile + home bundle at one price; loyalty that waives the activation fee). They are not any carrier's price card: plan prices run a few dollars below Verizon's as seen; device and offer figures elsewhere in this demo are the real ones. This file is content: the engine decides which plan LEADS inside 'Pair with a plan' (slot plan-pairing) and never a price, a discount or the multi-line arithmetic.
source: scratchpad research-telco-buying.md, parts (a) 6-7 and (b), from verizon.com/plans/unlimited/, /plans/unlimited/myplan/, att.com/plans/wireless/ and t-mobile.com/cell-phone-plans (seen 2026-09-30)

autopay.note: Prices are shown with AutoPay and paper-free billing; add $10 a line without it.

families.name: Simple
families.note: One flat price per line at any line count; less for switchers who bring a number.

families.name: Unlimited
families.note: Three tiers, Go, More and Max; the per-line price falls at 2, 3 and 4+ lines.

tiers.name: Simple

starter.label: Bring your phone and your number

includes: Unlimited 5G data (may slow when the network is busy)
Talk and text to Mexico and Canada
tiers.legal: Switcher price needs a number ported in from another carrier. Taxes and fees extra.

tiers.name: Unlimited Go

starter.label: Family starter: location sharing and a kids' watch line

includes: Talk and text to Mexico and Canada
tiers.legal: 4+ line price per line. Taxes and fees extra.

tiers.name: Unlimited More

starter.label: Hotspot & travel starter: 30 GB hotspot, travel days

tiers.legal: After 30 GB of hotspot data, speeds are reduced. Taxes and fees extra.

tiers.name: Unlimited Max

starter.label: Streaming starter: the streaming bundle included

tiers.legal: Streaming bundle included while on Unlimited Max. Taxes and fees extra.

bundle.name: Mobile + Home
bundle.note: One price with taxes and fees included, where 5G Home is available.

homeInternet.name: Vantage 5G Home
homeInternet.note: Available only where our 5G Home network covers the address; representative coverage in this demo.

loyalty.name: Vantage Rewards
loyalty.note: Members pay no activation or upgrade fee.

accessories.note: Percent off each accessory when you buy 2, 3 or 4+.

connectedDevices.note: On a new line (up to $500 off a watch and $600 off a tablet, as seen on verizon.com 2026-09-30); monthly line prices on Unlimited More and Max are halved for one and two devices.

storageMaths.note: A trade-in credit is capped at the base model's monthly price, so a storage step raises the net monthly cost by the full delta. The storage module says so.
